priority_definitions.P1: Financial correctness, cutoff, immutable history, authorization, or exactly-once control failure requiring remediation before reliance on the affected path.
priority_definitions.P2: Important bounded correctness, auditability, availability, scale or architecture defect; includes conditional/dormant paths.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] Approval lacks permission and maker-checker enforcement
issues.summary: Any supplied approver can approve a DRAFT directly. The domain does not compare approver with createdBy, require a submitted/requested state, or validate the approver identity. The HTTP approval/posting commands do not consume the trusted role context.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] Request bodies can forge journal audit actors
issues.summary: Event enrichment uses putIfAbsent for createdBy/auditUser, preserving caller-supplied names. The posting-contract route also copies body creator/audit fields without binding them to an authenticated caller.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] Posted journal headers and lines remain mutable
issues.summary: Public setters and add/remove/clear/setDetails do not check status. List.copyOf protects collection structure only; elements remain mutable. JPA callbacks update timestamps but do not enforce historical immutability.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] Reversal requests can repeatedly reverse the same posted journal
issues.summary: createReversal copies inverted lines and source lineage but does not claim the original or establish an enforced original-to-reversal relationship. The service assigns a fresh slip on each invocation, and the original remains POSTED.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] Concurrent requests can post one approved journal twice
issues.summary: Posting reads APPROVED without an exclusive lock, version or compare-and-set claim. Ledger entry detail references are nonunique, so two transactions can both validate and insert the same accounting movements.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] Concurrent postings overwrite account balance movements
issues.summary: GL/SL update reads absolute totals, adds amounts in Java and saves absolute totals. Neither balances nor reads have version/exclusive locking. PostgreSQL upsert overwrites with EXCLUDED totals rather than adding an atomic delta.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] Period status check and posting commit are not atomic
issues.summary: Posting rechecks the period before mutation, but the check does not reserve admission or hold a lock shared with final close. A close can complete between this read and the journal transaction's commit.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] Foreign journal creation does not enforce transaction-to-base conversion
issues.summary: Balance equality is enforced independently in each unit, but no invariant verifies baseAmount against transaction currency, exchange rate and rounding policy. The automatic rule engine assigns baseAmount=amount for every currency and does not apply an event FX rate; the contract adapter also defaults missing base to amount.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] Untyped event JSON loses cents before BigDecimal validation
issues.summary: Untyped decimal JSON becomes a Double under the default Jackson mapper. Rule interpolation stringifies the rounded floating-point value before its BigDecimal parser and ledger precision checks execute.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] Journal creation lacks an atomic idempotency contract
issues.summary: Manual/event creation always saves a new journal. The contract adapter only performs a check-then-create lookup on lineage, with no unique request key; it returns the first existing journal without comparing financial content. Kafka bypasses even that check.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] Slip numbers have only 65536 random values per day
issues.summary: The automatic number uses only four hexadecimal UUID characters. Unique slip storage detects a collision, but creation has no retry/sequence allocator. The daily key space is only 65536.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] Backdated posting leaves later GL and SL balances stale
issues.summary: Beginning balances are copied only when a daily row is first created. Posting on an earlier date changes that row but does not propagate or invalidate later projections.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] Reaggregation publishes deleted or partial balances and races with posting
issues.summary: Cleanup commits deletion of live GL/SL balances before independent chunk commits rebuild them from a live POSTED source. There is no source watermark, publication generation or posting/read exclusion protocol.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] Reaggregation restart dates drift with the wall clock
issues.summary: Absent explicit dates, the helper defaults to yesterday at execution time. Cleanup and the step-scoped reader resolve independently, and a restarted JobInstance retains its completed cleanup and reader offset.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] Core reaggregation trusts an unspecified source order
issues.summary: The direct core reaggregation query has no ORDER BY and the service preserves encounter order using LinkedHashMap. Carry-forward requires earlier days to have been saved first.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] String aggregation keys merge distinct subledger dimensions
issues.summary: Bulk keys substitute literal NULL for absent dimensions and join strings with '|'; query aggregation separately maps null to empty. These encodings are not injective.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] JPA rebuild cleanup materializes the complete balance range
issues.summary: The default JPA adapter loads all GL and SL balances for the requested range and passes those entities into deleteAllInBatch. The paged chunk100 reader does not bound this preparatory phase.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] Unmatched Kafka events complete without a journal or durable exception record
issues.summary: If rule selection returns Optional.empty, the listener logs a warning and returns normally. Its exception-based failure mechanism is not invoked and no unresolved-work record is persisted.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] Domain packages depend on JPA and Spring Data
issues.summary: Financial domain packages contain JPA mappings, lifecycle callbacks, a JPA converter and Spring Data repositories. Outbound application ports have improved service isolation, but the requested framework-free domain boundary is not met.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] Concurrent unsettled settlements can lose monetary updates
issues.summary: Settlement loads and modifies cumulative amounts without a version or exclusive lock. Durable reference replay protection handles sequential retries but does not serialize different references against the same open item.

issues.title: [journal-ledger] Kafka silently substitutes processing date for missing accounting date
issues.summary: An event without accountingDate is assigned LocalDate.now rather than rejected or resolved from immutable event evidence.

issues.title: [closing] Caller-controlled actors bypass closing authorization and reopen separation of duties
issues.summary: General closing commands accept user/requestedBy/approvedBy from query/body fields without binding them to trusted caller identity or enforcing closing permissions. Reopen separation of duties compares only those supplied strings.

issues.title: [closing] Active period locks and closing-in-progress do not block journal admission
issues.summary: lockPeriod stores a local PeriodLock, while isClosed reads only master CLOSED/PERMANENTLY_CLOSED. Starting a calendar changes its local status to IN_PROGRESS but leaves the master period OPEN. The Journal status adapter likewise does not consult local locks/calendar state.

issues.title: [closing] Remote fiscal transitions can commit before local closing approval
issues.summary: The HTTP master OPEN/CLOSED update commits independently before local calendar, audit and approval records commit. A lost response or later local failure rolls back only local work.

issues.title: [closing] Concurrent reopen decisions can contradict the final period state
issues.summary: Reopen approval and its calendar are read without a lock/version. Approval and rejection branches can both act on a stale PENDING snapshot and overwrite the final decision.

issues.title: [closing] Annual close reuses stale drafts after source activity changes
issues.summary: An existing deterministic annual slip with a matching date/description/type causes immediate return. Financial lines and source snapshot are not compared. A reopened year with an existing posted closing slip has the same short-circuit.

issues.title: [closing] Annual close accepts non-equity retained-earnings accounts
issues.summary: The supplied retained-earnings account is checked only for nonblank text. Journal account validation verifies historical existence, not whether it is an approved equity destination.

issues.title: [closing] Valuation and provision run APIs use configured constants instead of FX or ECL results
issues.summary: The API run paths read AutomatedJournalRule.amount and generate a fixed KRW draft. They do not invoke the real FX/ECL calculation services or inspect exposures, rates, finalized summaries and existing allowances.

issues.title: [closing] Final close does not require subledger and adjustment completeness evidence
issues.summary: A condition-free mandatory task and gate can be manually completed/passed, satisfying final close. No required AP/AR/lease/loan readiness, outstanding journal/adjustment, annual transfer or ECL reconciliation evidence is queried.

issues.title: [closing] Reclose reuses tasks and gates from the previous close cycle
issues.summary: Reopening changes calendar status but does not invalidate or version the prior completed tasks/passed gates. No close-cycle ID or source watermark ties evidence to the current financial state.

issues.title: [closing] Repeated run API calls create duplicate adjustment drafts
issues.summary: Each valuation/provision API request commits a fresh run ID. That ID becomes new lineage, so retrying the same business request creates a distinct draft. Journal success followed by execution-record failure can also leave an orphan draft behind a FAILED run.

issues.title: [closing] Concurrent lock and reopen-request creation bypasses uniqueness checks
issues.summary: Lock and pending-reopen checks are check-then-insert without unique active/pending constraints. Period lock indexes are nonunique, yet lookup expects one Optional result.

issues.title: [closing] Annual close loads full-year detail history with N+1 lookups
issues.summary: The annual service collects all summaries and every posted detail into memory. Each journal triggers detail lookup, and detail mapping performs historical master lookup. Remote deployment multiplies service calls.

issues.title: [closing] Annual close silently omits unclassified posted accounts
issues.summary: The detail adapter leaves category null when dated account lookup is absent. Annual close then filters for REVENUE/EXPENSES and silently discards unclassified lines rather than failing completeness validation.

issues.title: [closing] Closing domain models contain persistence framework dependencies
issues.summary: Financial domain classes are JPA entities with persistence callbacks and relationships. Port isolation at application boundaries does not satisfy the requested pure domain contract.

issues.title: [closing] FX valuation excludes earlier posted revaluation adjustments
issues.summary: The source includes only non-reporting-currency journals, while FX adjustment commands use reporting currency. Prior posted valuation adjustments never enter the carrying value used for the next valuation.

issues.title: [closing] FX valuation includes ineligible revenue and nonmonetary accounts
issues.summary: The source selects every account on foreign-currency journal lines. The service loads account metadata but does not apply monetary-item eligibility or historical-cost valuation policy; only the code is used.

issues.title: [closing] ECL provision mixes foreign targets with functional-currency balances
issues.summary: GL balances store baseAmount under a transaction-currency key. The allowance lookup returns that functional balance, but ECL subtracts it directly from the currency-specific target, duplicates the result into amount/baseAmount, and the journal adapter supplies exchange rate one.

issues.title: [closing] HTTP auto-post cannot resume an already approved adjustment
issues.summary: HTTP approveAndPost always issues approve then post. On restart, the adjustment adapter can reuse an APPROVED/POSTED journal, but repeated approval is illegal. The local JournalPostingAdapter has status-aware behavior that the HTTP implementation lacks.

issues.title: [closing] ECL stage totals are not reconciled with the posting target
issues.summary: Summary stage amounts are loaded and individually checked for nonnegativity, but their sum is never compared with the target. The provision service consumes only the target amount.

issues.title: [closing] ECL adjustment lineage drops confirmed run and model identity
issues.summary: The service checks single run/model input but discards those identifiers when grouping and creating journal lineage. The resulting reference contains caller batch ID, allowance account and currency. Upstream same-date summaries can be deleted and rebuilt.

issues.title: [closing] FX parallel cursors exceed the fixed single-connection source pool
issues.summary: The remote-source journal pool is fixed at one connection with a five-second acquisition timeout, while FX supports multiple concurrent cursor partitions. Each open cursor holds a connection.
